Overview

Garland is a city in TX with a population of 239,928. Dallas suburb with diversity, Lake Ray Hubbard, and no state income tax. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.7.
